{
  "test_name": "Ledger_2283_Objection3",
  "test_code": "// Copyright (c) All contributors. All rights reserved.\n// Licensed under the MIT license. See LICENSE file in the project root for full license information.\n\nusing System;\nusing System.Collections.Generic;\nusing System.Collections.Immutable;\nusing System.IO;\nusing System.Linq;\nusing System.Reflection;\nusing System.Threading.Tasks;\nusing MessagePack;\nusing MessagePack.SourceGenerator;\nusing MessagePack.SourceGenerator.Analyzers;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Diagnostics;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Emit;\nusing Xunit;\n\npublic class Ledger_2283_Objection3\n{\n    [Fact]\n    public async Task MetadataListAndDictionary_OfClosedGenericRecordStruct_GeneratesResolverAndAnalyzesCleanly()\n    {\n        string libSource = \"\"\"\nusing MessagePack;\n\nnamespace Lib\n{\n    [MessagePackObject]\n    public partial record struct Item<T>([property: Key(0)] string Key);\n}\n\"\"\";\n\n        string appSource = \"\"\"\nusing System.Collections.Generic;\nusing Lib;\nusing MessagePack;\n\nnamespace App\n{\n    [MessagePackObject]\n    public sealed partial record Cmd([property: Key(0)] string Scope)\n    {\n        [Key(1)]\n        public List<Item<int>> Items { get; init; }\n\n        [Key(2)]\n        public Dictionary<string, Item<int>> ItemMap { get; init; }\n    }\n}\n\"\"\";\n\n        await VerifyGeneratorAndAnalyzerAsync(libSource, appSource);\n    }\n\n    [Fact]\n    public async Task MetadataCollections_OfClosedGenericStruct_GeneratesResolverAndAnalyzesCleanly()\n    {\n        string libSource = \"\"\"\nusing MessagePack;\n\nnamespace Lib\n{\n    [MessagePackObject]\n    public partial struct PairItem<T>\n    {\n        [Key(0)]\n        public T First { get; set; }\n\n        [Key(1)]\n        public string Second { get; set; }\n    }\n}\n\"\"\";\n\n        string appSource = \"\"\"\nusing System.Collections.Generic;\nusing Lib;\nusing MessagePack;\n\nnamespace App\n{\n    [MessagePackObject]\n    public sealed partial class Cmd\n    {\n        [Key(0)]\n        public List<PairItem<int>> Items { get; set; }\n\n        [Key(1)]\n        public Dictionary<string, PairItem<int>> ItemMap { get; set; }\n\n        [Key(2)]\n        public IReadOnlyDictionary<string, PairItem<long>> ReadOnlyItemMap { get; set; }\n    }\n}\n\"\"\";\n\n        await VerifyGeneratorAndAnalyzerAsync(libSource, appSource);\n    }\n\n    private static async Task VerifyGeneratorAndAnalyzerAsync(string libSource, string appSource)\n    {\n        MetadataReference[] baseReferences = GetBaseReferences();\n        MetadataReference libReference = CompileToMetadataReference(\"Lib\", libSource, baseReferences);\n        MetadataReference[] appReferences = baseReferences.Append(libReference).ToArray();\n\n        CSharpParseOptions parseOptions = CSharpParseOptions.Default.WithLanguageVersion(LanguageVersion.Latest);\n        SyntaxTree appTree = CSharpSyntaxTree.ParseText(appSource, parseOptions);\n        CSharpCompilation appCompilation = CSharpCompilation.Create(\n            \"App\",\n            new[] { appTree },\n            appReferences,\n            new CSharpCompilationOptions(OutputKind.DynamicallyLinkedLibrary));\n\n        Assert.DoesNotContain(appCompilation.GetDiagnostics(), d => d.Severity == DiagnosticSeverity.Error);\n\n        object generator = new MessagePackGenerator();\n        ISourceGenerator sourceGenerator = generator switch\n        {\n            IIncrementalGenerator incremental => incremental.AsSourceGenerator(),\n            ISourceGenerator sg => sg,\n            _ => throw new InvalidOperationException($\"Unexpected generator type: {generator.GetType()}\"),\n        };\n\n        GeneratorDriver driver = CSharpGeneratorDriver.Create(\n            new[] { sourceGenerator },\n            parseOptions: parseOptions);\n\n        driver = driver.RunGeneratorsAndUpdateCompilation(\n            appCompilation,\n            out Compilation outputCompilation,\n            out ImmutableArray<Diagnostic> generatorDiagnostics);\n\n        Assert.DoesNotContain(generatorDiagnostics, d => d.Id == \"CS8785\" || d.Severity >= DiagnosticSeverity.Warning);\n\n        GeneratorDriverRunResult runResult = driver.GetRunResult();\n        Assert.NotEmpty(runResult.GeneratedTrees);\n        Assert.DoesNotContain(outputCompilation.GetDiagnostics(), d => d.Severity == DiagnosticSeverity.Error);\n        Assert.NotEmpty(outputCompilation.GetSymbolsWithName(\"GeneratedMessagePackResolver\", SymbolFilter.Type));\n\n        string generatedText = string.Join(Environment.NewLine, runResult.GeneratedTrees.Select(t => t.ToString()));\n        Assert.Contains(\"GeneratedMessagePackResolver\", generatedText);\n        Assert.Contains(\"Cmd\", generatedText);\n\n        var analyzerExceptions = new List<Exception>();\n        var analyzerOptions = new CompilationWithAnalyzersOptions(\n            options: null,\n            onAnalyzerException: (ex, _, _) => analyzerExceptions.Add(ex),\n            concurrentAnalysis: false,\n            logAnalyzerExecutionTime: false);\n\n        CompilationWithAnalyzers compilationWithAnalyzers = appCompilation.WithAnalyzers(\n            ImmutableArray.Create<DiagnosticAnalyzer>(new MsgPack00xMessagePackAnalyzer()),\n            analyzerOptions);\n\n        ImmutableArray<Diagnostic> allDiagnostics = await compilationWithAnalyzers.GetAllDiagnosticsAsync();\n        Assert.Empty(analyzerExceptions);\n        Assert.DoesNotContain(allDiagnostics, d => d.Id == \"AD0001\" || d.Severity == DiagnosticSeverity.Error);\n    }\n\n    private static MetadataReference CompileToMetadataReference(string assemblyName, string source, MetadataReference[] baseReferences)\n    {\n        CSharpParseOptions parseOptions = CSharpParseOptions.Default.WithLanguageVersion(LanguageVersion.Latest);\n        SyntaxTree syntaxTree = CSharpSyntaxTree.ParseText(source, parseOptions);\n        CSharpCompilation compilation = CSharpCompilation.Create(\n            assemblyName,\n            new[] { syntaxTree },\n            baseReferences,\n            new CSharpCompilationOptions(OutputKind.DynamicallyLinkedLibrary));\n\n        using var ms = new MemoryStream();\n        EmitResult emitResult = compilation.Emit(ms);\n        Assert.True(emitResult.Success, string.Join(Environment.NewLine, emitResult.Diagnostics));\n        ms.Position = 0;\n        return MetadataReference.CreateFromStream(ms);\n    }\n\n    private static MetadataReference[] GetBaseReferences()\n    {\n        var visited = new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.Ordinal);\n        var queue = new Queue<Assembly>();\n        var references = new List<MetadataReference>();\n\n        void Enqueue(Assembly assembly)\n        {\n            if (visited.Add(assembly.FullName ?? assembly.GetName().Name ?? string.Empty))\n            {\n                queue.Enqueue(assembly);\n            }\n        }\n\n        Enqueue(typeof(object).Assembly);\n        Enqueue(typeof(List<>).Assembly);\n        Enqueue(typeof(Enumerable).Assembly);\n        Enqueue(typeof(MessagePackObjectAttribute).Assembly);\n        Enqueue(typeof(MessagePackSerializer).Assembly);\n        Enqueue(Assembly.Load(\"System.Runtime\"));\n        Enqueue(Assembly.Load(\"System.Collections\"));\n        Enqueue(Assembly.Load(\"netstandard\"));\n\n        while (queue.Count > 0)\n        {\n            Assembly asm = queue.Dequeue();\n            if (!asm.IsDynamic && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(asm.Location))\n            {\n                references.Add(MetadataReference.CreateFromFile(asm.Location));\n            }\n\n            foreach (AssemblyName referencedName in asm.GetReferencedAssemblies())\n            {\n                try\n                {\n                    Enqueue(Assembly.Load(referencedName));\n                }\n                catch\n                {\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        return references.ToArray();\n    }\n}\n"
}
